goal: Verifier V1: Object size from Fit to glass objects must keep the ripple and film patterns on an object scaled by its Geometry COMP.

evidence: Reproduced the verifier's run exactly (fix-lit scratch, comp_scale_before.json). New preview test fit_size_carries_presets_over_comp_scale, COMP scale 0.1 and 10 with Object size = scale, camera and demo lights scaled with it, against the unscaled demo (max / pixels over 8): before, Aqua Jelly normal 82/81,761 and 55/81,843; Oil Slick film 255/93,644 and 255/94,099; finals of Aqua Jelly 226, Oil Slick 245, Prism Chrome 235/236 on 62,809 to 93,095 pixels; Frosted Ice 1/0 (no ripples or film). choice: (d): worldScale() = cube root of |det(mat3(world))| (moved out of wobbleNormal, same maths); wobbleNormal p = vObjPos * uWobble.y * scale; filmThickness uses vObjPos * uFilm.w * worldScale(). Uniforms, Fit and presets unchanged. The verifier asked for the fix in the core first; this task may only write inside liquid-glass-lit, so it lands here first and the core still has the old form.
consequence: A COMP scale k with Object size k (what Fit sets) or a SOP scale k with Object size k both give the demo's ripple and film count; Object size 1 on an unscaled object is unchanged. So wobble_independent_of_object_scale now sets Object size to the scale (review.md, changed expectations). Non-uniform scale uses the cube root, an average. Instance transforms are not in uTDMats.world, so instanced copies scaled per instance are not followed (as before for the wobble slope). Family: the core, Flow, Blobs and Prism need the same two-line change and test; until then lit's patterns differ from the core's on COMP-scaled objects.
